title: Pride Foods
body:
# Pride Foods
Pride Foods is a minecraft mod that adds pride themed foods to the game, pride flag, and some building blocks.

**Start by crafting a rainbow item**, crafted by combining red, orange, yellow, green, blue and purple dye.
You can find other recipes in the recipe book, or use a mod like JEI.

**Rainbow Staff**: A staff that can be used to tp (only when happy) or to kill players
- crouch + right click on entity: makes the entity float and wither away
- crouch + right click on an entity while having the happy effect: tp the entity into the void
- right click while being happy: teleports you to the location you are looking at
- left click (punch) an entity: gives them the wither effect for a short period

**Pride Flag**: Right click to rotate

**Foods**: Eat the pride themed Foods get effects

**Effects**: There are 2 effects, yummy effect and the happy effect. you can get the happy effect by eating pride themed food or by standing on a trans block. The yummy effect is obtained by eating a cupcake.

**Yummy effect**: You walk really fast and you eat the items you are holding (when hungry) _so be carefull with your sword while hungry!_

**Happy effect**: Your gravity gets removed when crouching, and heart particles spawn around you. you can also jump higher and use better features of items like the Rainbow staff. Fall damage also gets canceled.

I know i didn't add all gender type blocks, but I hope you can understand that this is a project that I did for fun. And i don't have infinite time, school ughh.
But if you really want something in the mod that isn't in it yet; you can always send me a suggestion :D
